title_en: Knowledge for Development, 49th Division of the Thai Army and Si Sakhon Regional Government jointly opened training sessions to strengthen skills among youth and citizens.
summary_en: The 49th Special Task Force Rangers, in collaboration with the Si Sakhon County Spokesperson and Learning Promotion Office, organized an AI learning promotion event for youth and local citizens at the Learning Promotion Office of Si Sakhon District, Narathiwat Province.

title_en: The 46th Infantry Division has joined forces with volunteers to help the people open drainage and alleviate flood problems.
summary_en: The 46th Special Task Force of the Rangers, under the command of the 4609th Brigade, led by volunteers in coordination with Green Shirt Group and Disaster Prevention and Relief Officers from Ko Kae Sato Local Government Organization, went to assist people at No.17 Ban Paon Patai Village, Block 1, Ko Kae Satosh, Rueso District, Narathiwat Province who were suffering from severe heat stroke.
